Kipferl 0.7.4 is a security update. It changes no commands and adds no
features.

## Security

- **`zip` 9.5.0.** The archive library behind the `zipfile` module and wheel
  inspection in `kipferl add` moves from 8.6 to 9.5, which fixes published
  archive-parsing advisories.
- **`rustls` 0.23.46** for HTTPS downloads.

## Behavior change in `zipfile`

Member names are now decoded as UTF-8 whenever they are valid UTF-8, and as
CP437 otherwise, whatever the entry's UTF-8 flag says. Before, the flag decided,
as in CPython. Only archives whose names are labelled with the wrong encoding
read differently.

## Package evidence

`kipferl deps verified` lists only `tzdata`, re-tested against this release's
own runtime on each platform. Other workflows on the package guide, such as
`trove-classifiers`, were tested against earlier runtimes and still need the
`--allow-unverified` command shown on their cards.

## Upgrade

Run `brew update && brew upgrade kipferl`, or download your platform's binary
and verify its adjacent checksum. `kipferl --version` reports `Kipferl v0.7.4`.

The embedded runtime changed, so runtime-bound dependency locks need a refresh:
rerun `kipferl add` for your declared requirements, review and commit the lock,
then run your application tests. Never edit hashes to bypass a mismatch.
Standalone applications you built earlier keep running.

Package evidence: https://kipferl.dev/docs/guides/package-audit
